scope: Keep retained ground reverse-engineering and holographic compatibility content available through PRE-CU profession ownership and authored item values, while removing their remaining NGE expertise, Luck, and custom multiplier authority and keeping the NGE inspiration pulse disabled.

The retained tool is already admitted through exact PRE-CU Tailor, Armorsmith, or Weaponsmith novice ownership and produces profession-specific clothing, armor, or weapon attachments/powerups.

Crafted tool station quality and enhancement-module resource quality are authored item properties and remain valid compatibility inputs; NGE reverse-engineering expertise, attachment-upgrade expertise, Luck, and a custom expertise multiplier are not PRE-CU authorities.

Publish 14.1 entertainer sessions use healing_dance_mind or healing_music_mind rather than the later inspiration pulse; the project already disables that pulse before its retained compatibility body executes.
The retained holographic backup helper has an authored base cap of one; later entertainer expertise only increased that cap.
